messages.content: Translate every English source unit into accurate, complete Modern Standard Arabic. Stay faithful to the supplied text; add nothing from memory or other Bible versions. Use natural, grammatically correct Arabic. Return JSON only with book_code and verses[{chapter,verse,text_ar}]. Return exactly one item for each source unit in the same order with exact numeric references. No Latin letters. Expected refs: 1:11, 1:12, 1:13, 1:14, 1:15, 1:16, 1:17, 1:18, 1:19, 1:20

{"book_code":"JASHER","units":[{"source_ref":"1:11","chapter":1,"verse":11,"text":"And Adam and his wife transgressed the command of God which he commanded them, and God knew it, and his anger was kindled against them and he cursed them."},{"source_ref":"1:12","chapter":1,"verse":12,"text":"And the Lord God drove them that day from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which they were taken, and they went and dwelt at the east of the garden of Eden; and Adam knew his wife Eve and she bore two sons and three daughters."},{"source_ref":"1:13","chapter":1,"verse":13,"text":"And she called the name of the first born Cain, saying, I have obtained a man from the Lord, and the name of the other she called Abel, for she said, In vanity we came into the earth, and in vanity we shall be taken from it."},{"source_ref":"1:14","chapter":1,"verse":14,"text":"And the boys grew up and their father gave them a possession in the land; and Cain was a tiller of the ground, and Abel a keeper of sheep."},{"source_ref":"1:15","chapter":1,"verse":15,"text":"And it was at the expiration of a few years, that they brought an approximating offering to the Lord, and Cain brought from the fruit of the ground, and Abel brought from the firstlings of his flock from the fat thereof, and God turned and inclined to Abel and his offering, and a fire came down from the Lord from heaven and consumed it."},{"source_ref":"1:16","chapter":1,"verse":16,"text":"And unto Cain and his offering the Lord did not turn, and he did not incline to it, for he had brought from the inferior fruit of the ground before the Lord, and Cain was jealous against his brother Abel on account of this, and he sought a pretext to slay him."},{"source_ref":"1:17","chapter":1,"verse":17,"text":"And in some time after, Cain and Abel his brother, went one day into the field to do their work; and they were both in the field, Cain tilling and ploughing his ground, and Abel feeding his flock; and the flock passed that part which Cain had ploughed in the ground, and it sorely grieved Cain on this account."},{"source_ref":"1:18","chapter":1,"verse":18,"text":"And Cain approached his brother Abel in anger, and he said unto him, What is there between me and thee, that thou comest to dwell and bring thy flock to feed in my land?"},{"source_ref":"1:19","chapter":1,"verse":19,"text":"And Abel answered his brother Cain and said unto him, What is there between me and thee, that thou shalt eat the flesh of my flock and clothe thyself with their wool?"},{"source_ref":"1:20","chapter":1,"verse":20,"text":"And now therefore, put off the wool of my sheep with which thou hast clothed thyself, and recompense me for their fruit and flesh which thou hast eaten, and when thou shalt have done this, I will then go from thy land as thou hast said?"}]}
